summary: Trekor Metals Limited, a Vancouver-based gold/silver producer formerly named Taseko Mines, filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, ownership change, or corporate action is disclosed; the exhibits are ordinary periodic reporting, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's quarterly report. Balance sheet shows C$2.77B assets, C$1.88B liabilities and C$893M equity; nine-month revenue C$909.9M and net income C$72.7M. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor apply. Watch only routine quarterly results, debt and Cariboo/Florence payment obligations.
